pro_course_detail.title: Workplace Mastering Confidence
pro_course_detail.description:
Self-Mastery: Reach Your Full Orgasmic Potential and Fulfilment at Work 
 
 Do you find yourself lacking confidence or having difficulties to be assertive at your workplace? This course is aimed at preparing you with tools and strategies that you need to be confident and to accomplish what you want in your career all in English.
 
 Key Topics: 
 
 Understanding Self-Confidence: Learn more about the elements that form self-confidence and the effects it has on one’s career. 
 Overcoming Imposter Syndrome: Understand how to counteract negativity and accept oneself for the capable person he or she is. 
 Effective Communication: Build up good communication skills to be able to voice yourself convincingly. 
 Body Language and Non-Verbal Cues: First, learn the trick to how to convey confidence through your body language. 
 Handling Stress and Pressure: Discover ways in how to remain calm and compose during a stressful period. 
 Negotiating with Confidence: Develop your negotiation skills to obtain good results. 
 Networking and Building Relationships: Improve your interpersonal communication skills in order to build your business circles. 
 By the end of this course, you will:
 
 Get more assertiveness and Self-confidence in your workplace. 
 Combat inadequacy complex and other kinds of distorted beliefs. 
 Engage in clear and assured oral and written communication in the work setting. 
 Always look good, be well groomed and self assured. 
 Develop good interpersonal skills and communication with other people. 
 Grow and develop yourself in every aspect of your life and reach your ultimate capabilities. Join me today and get ready to be the confident you at work you have always dreamed of being.

pro_course_detail.title: Everyday Conversations: Making Small Talk with Confidence
pro_course_detail.description: In this lesson, we’ll focus on building your confidence in everyday conversations. pro_course_detail.title: Conversational English
pro_course_detail.description:
Lesson Description: Conversational English for A2 to B1 Students 

- **Objective* I will help you build confidence in everyday conversations, whether you are at the A2 level or progressing toward B1. You will practice natural, real-life communication to improve fluency and understanding.  

- **Topics Covered: **  
  - Greetings and introductions (*Hello, Nice to meet you, where are you from? *)  
  - Small talk on everyday topics (*Weather, hobbies, work/school, family, weekend plans*)  
  - Asking and answering questions to keep a conversation going  
  - Expressing opinions and responding appropriately  

- **Lesson Structure: *  
  1. **Warm-up Activity: **  
     - Short discussion: *When do you greet someone? What do you say when meeting a new person?*  
     - Listening activity: Identify key phrases in a short, rec conversation.  

  2. **Presentation*  
     - I will introduce essential conversation starters and responses.  
     - We will analyse a natural dialogue, breaking it down into key expressions.  

  3. **Practice: **  
     - You will practice greetings and introductions in a guided activity.  
     - **Role-play exercise: ** You will simulate real-life scenarios, such as meeting a colleague, talking to a shop assistant, or introducing yourself at a social event.  
     -** Asking and answering follow-up questions to keep the conversation going.  

  4. **Production:**  
     - **Conversation Challenge:** You will pretend to move around and have mini-conversations with classmates, applying the phrases learned.  
     - I will give real-time feedback to help improve your fluency and accuracy.  

  5. **Wrap-up and Review:**  
     - We will discuss key takeaways from the lesson.  
     - You will share a new phrase or technique you learned today.  

- **Outcome:**  
  - By the end of the lesson, you will be able to confidently start and continue a conversation, ask relevant questions, and respond naturally in different social setting

- Sivumela ukuthi babuze uthisha imibuzo, sivumele ukuphindaphindwa kwezinto esim'qoka, futhi babheke ukuthi baluphendula/balamukele kanjani ulwazi. Sikhuthaza ukukhuluma futhi ukuthi bangabi namahloni ngokuthola ukulungiswa.

4. Focus on important things like what time it is, learn how to ask and answer these types of questions, independently of the teacher.
- Kugxilwa ezintweni ezibalulekile njengokuthi isikhathi sini, bafundiswe ukuphendula lemibuzo, ngaphandle kokusizwa nguthisha.

5. Basically learn how to handle basic, everyday conversations.
- Ngokuyisisekelo kufundwa ukuthi ungaziphatha kanjani izingxoxo eziyisisekelo, zansuku zonke.

6. Here we seek to introduce the student to the concept of counting. Separating singular from plural.
- Lapha sifuna ukwethula umfundi kumqondo wokubala nopkwehlukanisa ubunye kubuningi.

- Kuseshini yezinombolo, iphuzu ukuthi bafundiswe ukuthi babone ukuhlekeka kwezinombolo eziyinhloko. Lokhu ukuhlola ukuhleleka nokulandelana kokuhlaziywa kwekhwalithi.
